_doc: AI teammates (T-031). Tuning for gravelight/bots/*.gd; pure rules in bot_config.gd, unit-tested in gravelight/tests/unit/test_bots.gd.
_locomotion_doc: Update 03 section 3 (T-056): "v2" = bots move through BotLocomotion (gravelight/bots/bot_locomotion.gd, tuning in data/gravelight/ai/locomotion.json) on the human's own movement code; "v1" = the old BotBrain._move.

spawn_kit._doc: What every bot spawns with, on top of the start pistol: the guns in `weapons` (the one in `hold` goes into its hands) and the perks in `perks`, free and outside the power rule. Ironhide Stout is the Juggernog equivalent (250 health), Second Wind Schnapps the Quick Revive equivalent (2x revive speed). restore_after_down gives the kit perks back when the bot is revived or respawns (co-op loses every perk on going down); weapons come back on a respawn.

bonus_perk._doc: U02 section 5: at match start each bot gets one random perk free, outside the perk cap, kept when it goes down (its 'trait'). Drawn from the perks the map's machines sell, never a spawn_kit perk or an `exclude` one, no two bots the same (BotConfig.pick_bonus_perks). The settings toggle 'Bot Bonus Perk' (bot_bonus_perk) turns it off. The bot says a line about it (VO category BONUS_<perk token>) the first time it matters: `triggers` names the moment per perk (reload, fire, sprint, headshot, swap, explosion, overclock, hurt, revive); if that hasn't happened by `fallback_round`, it says it at that round's start.

local_ai._doc: One bot (squad index bot_index) gets a planner that picks its objective: the map's easter egg steps, the power, doors, perks, guns, the Crucible, boards, or sticking with the team. In mode 'local' a local LLM served by Ollama (endpoint) makes the pick every decide_every_s from a short text summary of the match and a numbered option list (structured JSON output, the option ids as an enum); the first installed model in `models` is used and kept loaded for keep_alive. When Ollama is unreachable, slow (timeout_s) or answers nonsense, the scripted planner (each option's own score) decides instead, so the bot never stalls. autostart_ollama runs `ollama serve` (hidden) when the API is down and the exe is found. The bot then roams the whole map for its objectives (no leash) and fights from where it stands. speak: the LLM's short remark as a subtitle in the bot's voice, at most every speak_cooldown_s.

scaling._doc: Each bot counts as this many players for zombie counts, the Foreman's health and the Bellringer count (rounded, capped at 4). 1.0 = exactly like a human teammate.

skill_aliases._doc: Update 03 section 7: the Bot Skill setting is Recruit / Veteran / Elite (default Veteran). The old preset names map here (a saved 'regular' plays as Veteran). The brain-layer numbers (reaction, aim convergence, decision noise, spend smartness) are in data/gravelight/ai/skills.json, merged over these by BotConfig.skill(). No skill changes damage taken (no hidden health buff).

follow._doc: Formation: standing still, slot_angles_deg around the leader's facing at slot_radius_m; while the leader moves faster than moving_speed_mps (training), moving_slots = [lateral_m, ahead_m] beside the heading, predicted lead_s ahead, so the bots move with the leader instead of camping. Out of the leader's line of fire (line_of_fire_*). Nudge: a human within nudge_near_m heading at the bot (nudge_cone_deg, nudge_min_speed) makes it step aside step_aside_m; a bot standing in a choke (an open door, a staircase, a passage narrower than 2 x narrow_half_width_m) with the human within choke_near_m moves out of it; choke_report_s is the soak test's stuck limit.

kill_share._doc: When the human has fewer than human_min_share of the last window kills (once min_sample kills are logged), bots leave zombies the human is aiming at alone unless they threaten someone.

combat._doc: window_target_priority raises zombies at windows; a bot backs away from anything closer than backpedal_radius_m while it shoots; melee_range_m is the knife; danger_radius_m / crowd_count / flee_hp_frac decide when it kites instead. Update 03: the free pistol refill at every round start is gone (no cheats); the decisions now come from data/gravelight/ai/*.json (actions, combat, economy).

ammo_box._doc: Update 02 section 4 / Update 03: a bot refills its main gun at the nearest ammo box (economy.json ammo_box_below, 25%; 60% between waves with Scrip to spare) when its own Scrip (or a companion's payer) covers the box price plus buffer_scrip.

shopping._doc: Update 03: the spending plan is data/gravelight/ai/economy.json (perk plan, guns for the round, the reserve, the crate, doors). What stays here: max_from_leader_m (T-031 errands), errand_timeout_s, the ammo box tuning, doors (round delay, per-round cap, door reserve) and the Crucible (min round, reserves, only in the break).

doors._doc: Bots buy closed doors: enabled, when scrip >= cost + reserve_scrip, at least round_delay_s after the round started, at most max_per_round_per_bot per bot per round; the door the human is looking at (within human_look_cone_deg) or nearest to is preferred (near_bonus_m - distance), within max_from_leader_m of the leader. Doors needing the power wait for it.

crucible._doc: The Crucible when the map has one: from min_round, with the upgrade price + reserve_scrip in hand, a bot feeds a gun that can learn something (the one in hand first), waits out the forge in front of it (shooting from there if it must) and takes its own result; never a teammate's. Only in the round break when only_in_break, never while the human is down; priority is its errand score (above boards 30, ammo 60). Upgraded ammo for the upgraded gun in hand under ammo_below_frac when the ammo price + ammo_reserve_scrip is in hand.

callouts._doc: Squad barks (BotSquad.callout): chance per category, one squad line at a time (cooldown_s), and per-bot per-category min gaps (per_bot_cooldown_s). RELOAD 'Reloading!', BOARD 'Board's up!', REVIVE 'I've got you', AMMO_LOW, POWERUP_SEEN, boss sightings, command acknowledgements (CMD_*), the bonus perk (BONUS_*).

commands._doc: The squad command wheel (hold bot_command, default T / D-pad down): follow (default), hold (the bots hold the spot the human points at, in a ring of ring_radius_m, and only repair boards within hold_repair_radius_m of it), repair (boards anywhere within repair_range_m of the leader, also mid-round when nothing is within repair_quiet_m), revive (revives first, even under fire; no shopping; a tight follow at revive_follow_m). Applies to every BotBrain (and later companions). point_range_m: how far the hold spot can be pointed. wheel_deadzone_px / wheel_radius_px: mouse travel to pick a segment. orders: the wheel's segments, clockwise from the top, each {id, label}; Update 03: every order is a high-weight action for 60 s or until done (data/gravelight/ai/actions.json orders): follow, hold, train (with the human's loop), repair, revive, buy_perks (perks now, the reserve ignored), save_scrip (no shopping), open_door (the door or power switch the human looks at), fetch_part (the buildable part the human looks at). The acknowledging line is VO category CMD_<ID>.
